read.product: Rated slightly above its furniture sub-categories (4.21 vs 4.12). But about 13% of buyers report a product problem: missing screws, misaligned holes, damaged panels and hard assembly.
read.fulfilment: 35% negative seller feedback over 90 days, 7 times the furniture median of 5% (Lukzer about 0%, Plantex 1%, The Sleep Company 17%). EVERS, at 41%, is the worst seller in the sample; FFO, at 19%, is on a par with Craftcenter.
read.verdict: Not met at 43.8. Furniture is not a forgiving category, so the seller problem is real, not category noise. Taking fulfilment out of the gate would still leave it at about 52.
